title: Workspace retrieval requirement
description: The rephraser's compact output: what the workspace must be, what it may cost, and the words that find each requested part of it. Only relevant categories are present; an omitted category is irrelevant. It carries NO SKU, NO PRICE of a product and NO PRODUCT NAME, because deciding what is wanted and how to look for it is a different stage from choosing which product supplies it.

workspace_intent.description: What the whole workspace is for. Empty lists are omitted. Never a search query: the reviewer holds a composed set against it.

total_budget.description: The monthly ceiling on the whole workspace, or nulls when no budget exists. A total is never derived.

is_explicit.description: True when the customer or the application stated it, false when no budget exists.

allocations.description: Optional component shares of a stated total. Omit entirely when no total exists. Every key must appear in categories, and the sum must not exceed the total.

categories.description: Only the categories that are relevant. Presence means relevant; an omitted category is irrelevant.

categoryKey.description: A catalogue category, never a workspace slot.

intentPhrases.description: At most four phrases. Never a product and never a category's search words.

retrieval_query.description: One concise sentence stating what the customer needs this thing to do. The slot's purpose, and never a product.

search_terms.description: The words this component's own request implies, as a catalogue would print them.

synonyms.description: Other words a catalogue might use for the same thing.

semantic_concepts.description: Short phrases about purpose, style or situation - uses rather than things.

items.description: One to three words a catalogue title could contain. Never a sentence and never a product name.

searchWords.description: At most three words in each list; the domain vocabulary limit still bounds the two lists together at eight.
